audit.title: Comprehensive Overhaul Test Audit - Every Code, Every Test, Every Thought
audit.scope: Complete system audit: 249 test files, 91 source files

critical_blockers.title: npm Dependencies Installation Failed
critical_blockers.description: ts-jest and other devDependencies failed to install properly. Jest cannot be executed.
critical_blockers.impact: Cannot run automated tests or generate coverage reports
critical_blockers.mitigation: Clean npm install in progress (background task)

critical_blockers.title: Coverage Verification Impossible
critical_blockers.description: Cannot run 'npm test --coverage' due to missing Jest module
critical_blockers.impact: No real coverage metrics available; cannot verify 80% threshold compliance

critical_blockers.title: package-lock.json Deleted
critical_blockers.description: package-lock.json was removed from git (D dashboard/package-lock.json)
critical_blockers.impact: Non-deterministic builds; different versions may be installed on different machines
critical_blockers.mitigation: Regenerate and commit package-lock.json after successful install

high.title: JWT Token Expiration Not Tested
high.description: No tests for expired token handling, renewal flows, or concurrent refresh attempts
high.impact: Security vulnerability: expired tokens might not be rejected properly

high.title: atomicTransaction() Function Not Tested
high.description: atomicTransaction() exported function has 0% test coverage
high.impact: Transaction batching might fail under load; no rollback testing

high.title: Weak Assertions in Test Suite
high.description: 20+ instances of non-deterministic assertions using toBeGreaterThan, toBeGreaterThanOrEqual
high.impact: Tests may pass/fail non-deterministically; reduced test reliability

medium.title: Missing Edge Case Tests
medium.description: 10+ edge cases not covered in test suite
uncovered_cases: Boundary value testing (max int, min int)

medium.title: Missing Error Message Validation
medium.description: Tests check status codes but not error message content or logging
medium.impact: Error messages might leak sensitive information; logging might be incomplete

medium.title: Type Casting to 'unknown' in Tests
medium.description: NextRequest mocked with 'as unknown as NextRequest' pattern (5+ instances)
medium.impact: Masks type errors; might test wrong interfaces

medium.title: Duplicate Type Definitions Across Tests
medium.description: Test interfaces (Alert, Task, MeetingLog, etc.) defined inline in multiple test files
medium.impact: Code duplication; harder to maintain; inconsistent definitions

medium.title: Lack of Parameterized Tests
medium.description: Concurrency tests use hardcoded values instead of parameterization
medium.impact: Hard to extend tests for different scenarios; code duplication

low.title: Missing Test Documentation
low.description: Some tests lack descriptive comments explaining the test scenario

low.title: No Performance Benchmarking Tests
low.description: No dedicated performance test suite for load testing, latency profiling

action_items.description: Test expired token rejection, refresh flows, concurrent refresh
acceptance_criteria: Covers happy path and error cases
Edge cases for race conditions tested

action_items.description: Test transaction batching, rollback, partial success scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Happy path and failure cases tested
Edge cases for concurrent transactions covered

action_items.description: Cover 10+ uncovered edge cases: large payloads, null bytes, Unicode, symlinks

acceptance_criteria: All tests updated to use new utilities

recommendations.recommendation: Fix npm dependencies and run full test suite immediately
recommendations.rationale: Cannot proceed without knowing actual coverage metrics

recommendations.rationale: Tests should be deterministic and reliable

recommendations.recommendation: Add JWT expiration and token lifecycle tests
recommendations.rationale: Critical security feature needs comprehensive testing

recommendations.recommendation: Add missing edge case tests to reach 80%+ coverage
recommendations.rationale: Current coverage estimated at 75-80%; need 5-10 more test cases

recommendations.rationale: Reduce code duplication by 50%; improve maintainability

final_verdict.summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive organization, but blocked by build issues and gaps in coverage
